Object keys: file=`file:<resource_id>:<file_sha256>:<parser_version>`; resource=`resource:<resource_id>`; source=`source:<source_id>`; source-year=`source_year:<source_id>:<YYYY>`. Each group also has an object_key=batch summary. Generate source-years from every enabled source × every configured year, including years with zero crashes.

| rule_id / producer | Required concrete objects | Pass criteria and disposition |
|---|---|---|
| QA01_INPUT / B, evidence from source owners | Every files member | Complete files; matching hashes/headers/formats/parsers and compatible releases. Unknown operations, draft official contracts, unexplained snapshot reductions or coverage shrinkage block. |
| QA02_RAW / B | Every file | Native rows=raw_count; fields, values, locators and deduplication agree. Missing/extra rows, omitted fields or a different payload at the same locator block. |
| QA03_PROJECTED / C, reviewed by A | Every crash/unit resource | Unique valid keys, correct dates/types/counts and scoped projection counts; same-source/release relationships. Invalid core values, orphans and join multiplication block. Unavailable coordinates go to QA07 without dropping crashes. |
| QA04_AUXILIARY / C | Every unit/person_raw/node_raw resource | Valid unit/person parent keys, non-empty Person vehicle references, and reconciled declared counts where scopes are confirmed equivalent. Orphans/unexplained differences block. Node duplicates alone do not block: record duplicate/conflict groups and isolate maps under 05/QA07. |
| QA05_SEMANTICS / C, reviewed by source owners | Every source | Versioned evidence for definitions, coverage, missing codes, categories, eligibility and reasons. New non-missing categories or unknown business definitions block; individual NULLs under explicit missingness rules may pass. |
| QA06_RECONCILIATION / D, reviewed by C/E | Every source-year | Canonical/fact key sets, same-named fields and eligibility agree row by row; zero differences in people, fatal crashes and all known_count aggregates; correct primary/location raw lineage and definition versions. Equal totals alone are insufficient. |
| QA07_LOCATION / C, summary reviewed by D | Every source-year | Eligible points have valid non-null coordinates, correct non-null CRS, correct location lineage and consistency evidence. All located or zero crashes: pass. Compliantly isolated missing/conflicting locations: limited. Unsupported eligibility, dropped crashes or invented CRS: block. |

Write results using 02. Both actual and expected contain `evaluated_count:int, violation_count:int, metrics:object`; expected.violation_count=0. Evaluation must reach the frozen expected coverage; checking fewer rows cannot pass. Fixed metrics follow. Inapplicable items are NULL with evidence, not invented zeroes.

| Rule | Fixed actual.metrics keys / expected.metrics decision |
|---|---|
| QA01 | hash_match, header_match, bundle_confirmed, contract_confirmed: boolean, all expected true. |
| QA02 | raw_count, distinct_locator_count, payload_mismatch_count: expected frozen raw_count, that same count, and 0. |
| QA03 | input_count, excluded_count, projected_count, duplicate_key_count, orphan_count, invalid_value_count: input=raw_count; projected=input-excluded; last three=0. Independently verify exclusions using valid parent-crash scope. |
| QA04 | orphan_count, nonblank_unmatched_count, declared_count_delta, duplicate_group_count, coordinate_conflict_group_count: applicable first three=0. The final two Node observations have expected=NULL, meaning no zero requirement, but must be documented and handled by QA07. This is not a generic skip switch. |
| QA05 | undefined_category_count, unconfirmed_definition_count, eligibility_error_count: all expected 0. Contract-declared missingness is not a new category. |
| QA06 | missing_fact_count, extra_fact_count, field_mismatch_count, lineage_error_count, definition_error_count, crash_delta, fatal_crash_delta, fatality_delta, casualty_delta, fatal_crash_known_delta, fatality_known_delta, casualty_known_delta: all expected 0. Compare NULLs explicitly; subtraction must not silently discard them. |
| QA07 | crash_count, map_count, unmapped_count, invalid_eligible_count: crash_count equals source-year facts; map_count+unmapped_count=crash_count; invalid_eligible_count=0. Independently derive expected crash/map counts from observations; do not copy the result being tested. |

Batch summary metrics are object_count, pass_count, limited_count, block_count, missing_count. object_count equals the required concrete-object count; block/missing are zero. Summary evaluated_count counts concrete objects. Aggregate affected counts from concrete results only, never double-count the summary. qa_summary returns seven entries containing rule_id, result and affected_count for B/D.

evidence contains `reason_codes[], resolution, references[], producer_version`. References include resource, hash, row_locator and raw_record_id where available. Large exception sets may reference a detail file with SHA256 and total rows; a screenshot without counts is insufficient. B provides evidence paths through the run context; C/D/E must not invent incompatible locator conventions.

pass requires affected_count=0; block counts distinct violating objects/rows. For QA07 limited, affected_count counts distinct unmapped crashes, while violation_count=0 means no invalid point was allowed through. Every affected crash requires a reason. Only QA07 permits limited. Zero crashes produce NULL coverage and pass, not fabricated 100% coverage.

E independently derives required objects, checks completeness, then aggregates: any block → block; otherwise valid QA07 limited → limited; otherwise pass. Never fill missing/unexecuted results with pass. Summaries do not replace concrete checks; additional blocking checks also prevent publication. A group with no applicable objects still records a batch summary explaining the empty set. Write successful-batch results once, without overwriting them to turn them green. Retries create new batches. Publication requires all seven summaries and all expected concrete results to satisfy the gate together.
